message.reasoning:
The user wants me to compare two images and select the correct description of what happened.

Let me look at the first image. A robot arm is holding a clear plastic container (looks like a small cup or box) filled with nuts. The container is tilted, and some nuts are visible. Below it is a clear plastic cup on the table, which appears mostly empty (maybe a few nuts at the bottom).

In the second image, the robot arm is holding the same container, but now it appears empty (or nearly empty). The cup on the table now contains a substantial amount of nuts.

So between the two frames, the nuts were poured from the container into the cup. The container in the second frame looks empty, suggesting all the nuts were poured out. Let me look carefully. In the first frame, the container has a good amount of nuts. In the second frame, the container looks empty/transparent with no visible nuts. The cup in the second frame has a heap of nuts.

So the action is pouring all the nuts into the cup. Option B says "poured all the nuts into a cup." Option C says "poured some of the nuts."

Looking at the second frame, the container appears empty. So "all" seems more accurate. The cup now has a lot of nuts. So B is correct.

Let me double check the first frame: the cup on the table looks empty (clear). The container has nuts. Second frame: container empty, cup full. So all nuts transferred. Answer B.

Thus the answer is B.
